scientific_integrity: The three-dimensional normalized product identity is proved exactly from polar cross-sections. Finite checks are corroborative. The originality search was bounded; priority is not guaranteed.
scientific_limitations: Only three-dimensional centered Euclidean capsules with positive radius and finite segment length are covered.
The deficit parameter measures axial elongation within this family, not global Banach–Mazur distance.
No general sharp Blaschke–Santaló stability theorem or universal lower minimizer is claimed.
An older formula outside searched records may exist.
title: Exact quadratic Blaschke–Santaló deficit for three-dimensional Euclidean capsules
